dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_training_mas: Forgotten already? Fine. As many times as it takes.
Fine. I'll take you through it from the top.
Going up a back? Then show me your forms on the dummies. Learn, slot, hit, circle, stance. That's all.
I can undo every skill you've learned, right here. Free until Lv 15. If you're unsure, try things. If they don't fit, respec again.
Understood. If your hands freeze on a back, come back here.
lesson.skyabyss.hint.behind: Circle to the light behind a dummy and strike
lesson.skyabyss.hint.learn: Press %s, then learn a glowing skill
message.skyabyss.lesson.reward: You received bell coins for finishing the lesson.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.behind: That's it. The beasts on a back don't watch their own backs either.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.cast: Mana is the bar beside your HP. While a skill recovers, keep swinging.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.finish: That's the lesson. Come back whenever you forget.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.learn: Good. The key on the slot is how you use it.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.stance: One stance at a time, and each swap takes a moment.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.tree_abyss: The Abyssal Mystic tree has opened. There's a new tab on the skill screen.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.tree_deep: Reborn, you can now see the tree of the Deep. More open with each rebirth.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.tree_hybrid: Learn three skills in each of two trees and the bridge between them opens. Find it on the ring of the skill screen.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.tree_keyston: Keystones open at Lv 20. They sit at the bottom of each tree and define a build. Pick one.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.tree_past: Past-life skills have opened. Past-life points are spent separately from your usual points.
message.skyabyss.lesson.say.tree_star: The sealed Astromancer tree has opened. There's a new tab on the skill screen.
message.skyabyss.lesson.skipped: Lesson skipped. Ask the training master any time to take it.
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.behind.jour: Circle behind a dummy and strike. Hits from behind grow much stronger with skills like Wind Rend.
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.cast.hit: Hit a dummy with a skill twice
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.cast.journa: Hit a dummy with the skill. Skills cost mana and need time to recover. Once it's ready, hit again.
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.done: You've learned the basic forms. If you lose your way on a back, the yard is always here.
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.learn.journ: Skills are learned with points on the skill screen. A new skill drops into an empty slot and is used with that slot's key.
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.learn.slot: Learn a skill and slot it
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.meet.journa: Once in the capital, call on the training master. Every whale chaser, they say, beats the dummies here before going up.
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.meet.meet: Ask the training master for a lesson
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.reset.journ: Last, ask the master about respecs. The skills you learn can be chosen again later.
quest.skyabyss.lesson.skills.stance.jour: Switch your stance. Guard is sturdy, Swift is fast, Song recovers mana faster. Pick one before a fight.
